spots.title: Main Street Bridge
spots.blurb: Today's bridge crosses the freeway. Until the 1950s, an arched bridge of 1906 crossed the creek here.

spots.title: The Mill Annex
spots.blurb: All that remains of the four-storey flour mill James Alexander Forbes built in the 1850s.

spots.title: Town Plaza
spots.blurb: Under the old cedar, you find your voice. Tap Meow and people nearby stop to say hello.
